original_test_intent: Validate the explicitly authorized E1.S NVMe drive/namespace can sustain the approved MODS read/write workload with correct data integrity and qualified performance while preserving device health and avoiding any unapproved data loss.
original_method: Select by row/variant, not shared code; obtain signed MODS module/recipe; bind chassis bay, slot, PCIe BDF, NVMe controller serial/model/firmware, namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID and device path; prove the target is disposable or backed up and exclude boot/mounted/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/unknown media; record SMART/error logs; run one approved pattern/block-size/depth/duration/verification scope; preserve full results and post-health; stop writes on any target mismatch, reset, media/integrity/error anomaly.
manual_activity: A storage owner physically/logically verifies the E1.S target, backup/disposable status and isolation, authorizes the exact write scope and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Unique identity resolution for the duplicated code and MODS package/module version/hash/license
E1.S bay/slot/BDF/controller serial/model/firmware and namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID-to-path map
Pattern/read-write mix, block size, queue depth/jobs, address range/size, duration, verify method and performance/error thresholds
Disposable/backup proof, mount/boot/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper exclusions, endurance budget and recovery/restore plan
safety_requirements: Never select the case by code alone or choose `/dev/nvme*` by enumeration order
Resolve stable controller/namespace identity and every storage-stack holder before any write
Require explicit approval of destructive range and verified disposable/backup state
Stop immediately on identity drift, unexpected mounted/held target, reset, timeout, media error, integrity mismatch or health degradation
Preserve logs; never retry writes automatically
agent_execution_scope: Enforce row/variant identity and exclude PCH sensor evidence
Perform read-only target/holder/SMART/error/endurance checks and validate the exact MODS recipe
After explicit approval, run only the bound write scope once and collect full output/verification/health evidence
Do not choose target, unmount/alter stacks, clear logs, rerun failed I/O, restore data or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve duplicate-code ownership while preserving both rows
Approve MODS module, exact E1.S namespace, destructive scope, endurance/performance/integrity criteria and backup
Supervise storage isolation/recovery and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `mods -h` proves only binary presence; its malformed/truncated SSH form does not identify the NVMe target or execute/verify read-write coverage. No write command is valid from TBD data.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After composite identity, stable namespace, storage-stack exclusions, backup and explicit approval, execute the exact vendor MODS E1.S recipe once with full output and synchronized NVMe health/error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's 10/10-minute estimates remain; target, pattern, range, queueing, duration and criteria are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH DESTRUCTIVE PACKAGE-GATED E1S NVME READ-WRITE AND INTEGRITY TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind a disposable namespace by stable identifiers, prove it is outside every active storage stack, then run one approved verified I/O profile with pre/post health accounting.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds collision-safe identity, target provenance, data-loss/endurance controls, complete workload semantics, verification and recovery without inventing TBD fields.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: MODS availability or generic NVMe enumeration cannot prove safe target selection, actual write coverage, integrity or health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A mistaken namespace can destroy the OS or user data; even an approved target incurs wear and a reset may leave it requiring vendor recovery.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must say whether the module writes the full namespace or a reserved LBA region and whether destructive erase/format/sanitize is prohibited. Endurance consumption and performance expectations must match the installed E1.S SKU and thermal state.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2012 PCH sensor
Approved MODS package/module/recipe and exact workload/criteria
Bay/slot/BDF/controller serial/model/firmware plus namespace stable IDs and path
Disposable/backup approval and read-only proof of boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/dm exclusions
Pre/post SMART/error/endurance/temperature plus full MODS stdout/stderr/exit/throughput/integrity result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Wistron-HW-00482-V002 identifies both row 2012 PCH Sensor Check and row 2201 MODS NVMe/E1.S Read/Write. Row/hash/variant makes this review reliable, but code-only selection is unsafe; Procedure and Criteria here are also TBD and require approved storage semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The NVMe/E1.S read-write intent is identifiable. Vendor module, exact disposable target, parameters, criteria and recovery are supplyable prerequisites.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2201 Wistron-HW-00482-V002: assign/approve a unique identity distinct from row 2012 PCH Sensor; approve MODS package/module/version/hash/license and exact command; E1.S bay/slot/BDF/controller serial/model/firmware and namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID target; destructive/read-only range, pattern, block size, depth/jobs, duration, verify/performance/error/endurance limits, backup/disposable proof, active-stack exclusions, aborts and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents duplicate-code dispatch and catastrophic target guessing while converting the TBD storage test into a stable-identity, explicitly approved integrity and health contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: Storage writes are unsafe until the precise namespace and LBA scope are proven. Linux device names are unstable and cannot distinguish an E1.S test target from boot or array members. This row also shares its code with an unrelated PCH sensor check, so selection needs the variant. The vendor recipe must expose actual write/verify semantics and endurance cost; once approved, one execution is sufficient, and any reset, media error or mismatch is preserved rather than retried.
